news.title: Steve Martin: In pursuit of nearly perfect battery materials, performance
news.summary_en: Iowa State University's Steve Martin has answers about the state of his work with batteries and glassy materials. Martin won a major, international award earlier this year that recognizes his engineering achievements.

news.title: Classroom solution evolves into public resource for navigating AI tools
news.summary_en: As artificial intelligence tools evolve at a rapid pace, an Iowa State computer science professor and her students are developing a public website that tracks new AI releases and helps users make sense of the fast-changing technology.
